candidates.raw_title: NMPA approval items, Nov 2026 (dupilumab CRSwNP combo-indication; efgartigimod alfa CIDP; 3 Nov 12 approvals)
candidates.reject_reason: Dupixent+intranasal-corticosteroid combo-use CRSwNP indication (announced as 'Nov 4') is an indication expansion with no SC/concentration/device angle disclosed -- Gate A reject. The three Nov 12 approvals (sinovorant, orforglipron, rivosertanib) are not SC delivery items and not on the Tier-5 molecule list -- Gate A reject. The efgartigimod alfa SC CIDP item surfaced here is the same item investigated in detail below (see findings) -- its apparent 'Nov 2026' date was a confirmed search-tool mis-date; true event date 2024-11-11, logged separately as a finding rather than rejected.

candidates.raw_title: Zai Lab / argenx: NMPA approves VYVGART Hytrulo (efgartigimod alfa SC) for CIDP in China
candidates.gate_e: Fills an installed-base completeness gap on the already-tracked ENHANZE row: a China-specific, indication-specific approval of an ENHANZE-enabled product directly extends the tracker's picture of who has actually gotten an rHuPH20-enabled high-volume SC product to market and where -- the core installed-base half of the tracker's question.

candidates.raw_title: Zai Lab / argenx: NMPA approves efgartigimod alfa SC for gMG in China (date disputed: Jun 30 IV vs 'July' SC)
candidates.reject_reason: Sources disagree on whether the SC-formulation gMG approval is a distinct 2024-07 event from the 2024-06-30 IV-formulation gMG approval (Reuters); no primary Zai Lab/argenx press release for a 2024-07 SC-specific gMG approval was located to resolve the ambiguity. Per Step 1.5.1, an item whose date cannot be confirmed must not be logged under an asserted date -- rather than log a guessed or conflated date, this candidate is held out this run pending a primary source.

findings.event: China NMPA approval of VYVGART Hytrulo (efgartigimod alfa SC, ENHANZE-enabled) for CIDP
findings.source_name: Zai Lab (investor-relations press release); corroborated by BusinessWire and Euronext
findings.summary: China's NMPA approved VYVGART Hytrulo (efgartigimod alfa + hyaluronidase, ENHANZE-enabled) for CIDP in adults, the first and only NMPA-approved CIDP therapy in China, dosed as a fixed 1,000 mg once-weekly SC injection given in 30-90 seconds.
findings.summary_ko: 중국 NMPA는 VYVGART Hytrulo(에프가티지모드 알파+히알루로니다제, ENHANZE 기반)를 성인 CIDP 적응증으로 승인했으며, 중국에서 NMPA 승인을 받은 최초이자 유일한 CIDP 치료제다. 1회 1,000mg 고정용량 주 1회 피하주사로 30-90초에 투여된다.
